value.rationale: The exact quotient singular curves, canonical models, isolated singularity types and two Euler invariants are natural motivically linked data for a named terminal Log Enriques fourfold introduced in 2026. They distinguish the coarse topology from the commuting-pair orbifold invariant, identify a genus-four canonical stratum and the two kinds of terminal singularity, and provide input to future topological/orbifold and birational comparisons without requiring a large downstream theorem. This is not merely repeating the known fixed locus upstairs.
